+title: 'AG-8c AgentsGraph: changes(after:) subscription and cursor from the ChangeLog (blocked on EXTRAS-10)'
+---
+## Blocked
+Blocked on EXTRAS-10 (`ChangeLog<Event>` and the toolkit codes `NOT_FOUND`/`RESYNC_REQUIRED` in FoundationModelsExtras, features/packages/foundationmodels-extras.md:122). EXTRAS-10 has no owner yet. Do not write a local seq/buffer: EXTRAS-9 rule 2 forbids a copy of a toolkit part. Start after Extras main has `ChangeLog`, and adopt that Extras commit first.
+
+## What
+EXTRAS-9 rule 9 (D67) for the `agents` endpoint:
+- `Subscription.changes(after: Int): AgentChange!`. `AgentChange` has `seq: Int!`, `at: DateTime!`, and `ids: [ID!]!` of the agents that a reload added, changed or removed (and, if useful, `kind` per id). The client queries `agent(id:)` again for the new value; a removed id gives `null`.
+- `Query.cursor: Int!`: the `seq` of the catalog that a query reads. Query and cursor read one generation, so a client that reads `agents` then `changes(after: cursor)` misses no change.
+- An `after` that is no longer in the buffer gives `RESYNC_REQUIRED`; no `after` starts from now.
+- Feed: one `ChangeLog<AgentChange>` per `AgentRegistry`, fed by `onReload` (the dotfolder watcher, `layerUpdates`, and an explicit `reload()` — so AG-9 writes also show). Diff consecutive catalogs by id and by the content of each definition (file content/modification, frontmatter, layer); a reload with no difference appends nothing. Diagnostics-only changes count as a change of the agent they name.
+- Alias tables: `agentChanges`, `agentsChanges` → `changes`; `since` → `after`.
+- Remove the rule-9 exception from the conformance test of AG-8a.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+- [ ] Adding, editing and removing `<name>/AGENT.md` in a watched layer each give one `AgentChange` with that id and a larger `seq`.
+- [ ] `cursor` equals the `seq` of the last event; `changes(after: cursor)` gives only later events.
+- [ ] A too-old `after` gives `RESYNC_REQUIRED`.
+- [ ] A reload with no difference gives no event.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `GraphQLEndpointConformance.problems` is empty with no exception, with an alias probe for `agentChanges`.
+- [ ] The schema golden is updated.
+- [ ] Subscription tests over `TemporaryLayer` with explicit `reload()` (no wall-clock waits; each wait also ends on failure, test rule T1). #AG-8 #blocked
\ No newline at end of file
